concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but creates the same directory tree and `.gitkeep` files that other scaffold tasks may also create. Concurrent execution could cause race conditions on directory creation or file overwrites, violating the safety implied by `[P]`.

Task T002 is marked `[P]` yet writes `requirements.txt` and `config.yaml`, which are later read by many pipeline scripts. If T002 were run in parallel with any consumer task, those consumers could read a partially‑written file, breaking the producer‑before‑consumer guarantee.

Task T003 is marked `[P]` but populates the `contracts/` directory with schema files that are validated by subsequent tasks (e.g., T004‑T008). Parallel execution with any consumer could lead to schema validation failures if the contracts are not yet fully written.
